slot_note: seed DA24 (quantity only: a count on a distribution read against a fixed limit); architecture 2 re-rooted after architecture 1 was spent at stage 4
niche: a health district examination survey's 2025 wave, used to choose the counties where the district's 2027 vitamin D programme opens first (more than 30 per cent of adults below 20 ng/mL on the reference method's scale), when one accuracy check measured the laboratory's immunoassay under one calibration and the survey's December re-assays of stored duplicate aliquots, run under one later calibration, are the only link from it to every other calibration of the year
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly pools the December re-assays of stored duplicates by the reagent lot and analyzer each original result carries, adds the October accuracy check's bias for the lot and analyzer it measured, weights each county and names a wrong set of counties: the immunoassay's bias is set at each calibration, the calibrator lot changed three times on its own dates and routine recalibrations moved it again, so the check speaks only for the calibration it ran under and each county's results sit under calibrations whose shifts differ from their reagent lot's pooled average; dividing every result by the check's bias files another wrong set.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a population prevalence from survey biomarker measurements standardised to a reference measurement procedure the way a survey laboratory standardises an immunoassay: each result's bias is the bias of the calibration it was measured under, carried from the one accuracy-based check to every calibration of the year by re-assays of stored duplicate aliquots in one run and read on the reference scale at the clinical cut-off; with a questionnaire score or a meter in place of the assay there is no calibration, no stored duplicate and no reference procedure to carry, and the task stops making sense.
layer2_pattern: own:a reference bias measured under one calibration, carried to every calibration of the year by re-assays of stored duplicates in one run, read per calibration rather than pooled by reagent lot
layer1: laboratory results in local time against a run log in UTC across daylight saving
results below and above the reportable range as text
re-assay records under the respondent's specimen identifier
survey weights in a separate file keyed on respondent
the accuracy check's table inside a PDF report
stakeholder_role: chief statistician, regional center for health statistics

spine.entity: one event on one vial (collected, processed, frozen, shipped, received, accessioned, assayed, stored, pulled, thawed, returned)

world.geography: United States (the health district, its survey, laboratory and people are fictional)
world.org_type: regional health district's center for health statistics, which runs the health and nutrition examination survey, and its contracted hospital laboratory
invented_names: Merrivane Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

driver: The decisive quantity is which groups of a weighted population have more than a share below a line on a reference scale, when one check measured the instrument's bias under one calibration and a random subsample was measured again in one later run; the bias is set at each calibration, which changes more often than the labelled batch, so shifts pooled by batch leave the groups measured under calibrations far from their batch's average on the wrong side of the line, and only each reading's own calibration's shift, anchored at the calibration the check ran under, names the set.
driver_concrete: Which of eight counties had more than 30 per cent of adults with 2025 examination serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D below 20 ng/mL on the reference measurement procedure's scale: each result divided by the bias of the calibration it was measured under, that calibration's shift read from the December re-assays of stored duplicate aliquots of results measured under it and anchored at the calibration the October accuracy check ran under; not the reported results, not the check's bias on every result, not the re-assay shifts pooled by reagent lot and analyzer.
stump: A competent analyst pools the December re-assays by reagent lot and analyzer, adds the October accuracy check for the lot and analyzer it measured and names the wrong counties, or divides every result by the check's bias and names fewer; the calibrator lot changed on its own dates and every recalibration moved the assay's bias, so only each result's own calibration's shift, read from the re-assays of results measured under it and anchored at the check's own calibration, names the golden set.

differentiation.task274: architecture 1 rebuilt survivors forward from additions through a fitted survivor curve to recover unrecorded ages; this carries a measured instrument bias to every calibration through paired measurements of the same specimens, with no curve, no ages and no survival
differentiation.task243: task243 recovers the share of a population's exits a register records from a growth balance between two counts disturbed by migration; this standardises a laboratory measurement to a reference scale per calibration through re-assays of the same specimens, with no balance, no exits and no migration
differentiation.task450: task450 links two forms through shared items answered by different groups and screens the drifting items; here the same specimens are measured twice, so no group difference is separated and nothing is screened, and the decisive move is the grain of the correction, each calibration rather than the labelled reagent lot

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-23 at stage 4 on Gate F: the isolated scored reader fitted a Makeham-Weibull survivor curve to the plant ledger's balances, rebuilt each pre-1987 vintage's survivors from its additions and committed the golden 33,000 (asks 14 of 19)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units in service are at least a given age when many units' start dates were never recorded and are missing more often the older the unit; the units still in service from each start year are that year's intake times the chance of lasting to its present age, a curve fitted to the yearly outflow of the unrecorded group, so the unrecorded units are spread over start years by what that leaves once the recorded ones are taken out, not like the recorded ones and not in proportion to intake.
lineage.driver_concrete: How many of Kestrin Valley Electric Cooperative's distribution poles on the 30 September 2026 register were set in 1977 or earlier, with the poles that have no year of setting spread over the pre-1987 years as each year's additions times a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's year-end balances from 1938 to 2025, less the poles of that year whose brand was read; not spread like the poles whose year is known, not in proportion to additions, and not on a curve whose shape cannot follow the ledger.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst who parses every brand and reads every account spreads the poles with no year of setting like the poles whose year is known, or in proportion to each year's additions, and files a count of poles 50 or older thousands off; brands fade with age, so the poles with no year are the oldest, and each year's survivors are its additions thinned by decades of retirements that climb after forty years, so only a survivor curve fitted to the ledger's balances, applied to each year's additions, says how many poles of each age are still standing.
lineage.niche: a rural electric cooperative's 2027 full groundline inspection, sized by how many of its wood poles will be 50 or older, when about one pole in nine in service carries no year of setting

notes: Re-rooted 2026-10-23 after architecture 1 was spent at stage 4 (Gate F). Drawn from seed DA24's quantity only (a count on a distribution read against a fixed limit); world redrawn. Architecture 2 was first filed as a county-wide count corrected per reagent lot and analyzer (f2830db8); at stage 2 the count proved to need only the average bias, and per lot and analyzer pooling is the reflex a reader takes with re-assays in hand, so the call became a county designation and the decisive grain the calibration. Axes redrawn on re-registration: strategy decomposition_attribution (banned on task177 v3) to composition_mix, the honest family once the move is each county's own mix of calibrations against its reagent lot's pooled mix; context artifact filed_standard (task177 v3) to close_out_summary, the wave's fieldwork close-out that ships; forcing event launch_or_rollout (task178 v3) to vote_or_meeting, the board's vote on the programme's first counties. WARNs answered in the design note's Draw. Two draws refused before this one: an engine-hours warranty risk set (the integration lever 0.92 to 1.07 of mean imputation) and a chain of lot verifications (estimator spread 900 to 5,600 on 18,000). Architecture 2 spent 2026-10-23 at stage 4 on Gate F: both isolated scored readers built the per-calibration bridge from the December re-assays, anchored the October check at its own calibration and committed the golden four counties (asks 0 of 32 each). Architecture 3 not drawn: no candidate cleared the re-root screens (the design note's last Tried and rejected line), so the number retired 2026-10-23; this card keeps architecture 2's identity, with architecture 1 in its lineage.
